name: Apple Pay checkout
description: Pays for physical goods and services with Apple Pay through a payment processor, using SwiftUI's PayWithApplePayButton with a configuration message until a merchant ID is set.

credentialsNeeded.description: Your Apple Pay merchant identifier, for example merchant.com.example.app

cost.note: No Apple fee for Apple Pay; your payment processor charges per transaction; a merchant ID needs an Apple Developer Program membership

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Use for physical goods and services (food, rides, merchandise). Show `ApplePayCheckoutButton(lines:merchantName:onAuthorize:)` with `PaymentLine(label:amount:)` items; the last line is the total. In `onAuthorize(payment, complete)`, send `payment.token.paymentData` to your server and payment processor, then call `complete(true)` or `complete(false)`. Until APPLE_PAY_MERCHANT_ID is set it shows a configuration message. Never charge cards from the app itself.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify apple-pay` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
